ModMetaData.name: Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Beta release.
Rebalances cold tolerance for all living PlantDefs in supported plant sets by separating minimum-growth temperature from cold-death behavior. Supported plants receive explicit minimum-growth values plus either a fixed cold-death temperature or non-lethal cold dormancy below their minimum growth temperature; dormant plants stop growing and become leafless in the cold instead of dying, then recover after warming. The relevant temperature is shown in the plant Info Card.
The current balance is generally more demanding than the original Vanilla / Medieval Overhaul settings, making crop choice, forestry, seasonal timing, and temperature management more important. Selected perennial and overwintering plants instead gain cold dormancy.
Includes balance for all 49 living Core PlantDefs plus all 29 Medieval Overhaul 1.6-specific PlantDefs when MO is present. Wild-only vegetation is included; dead stump/remnant Defs are excluded. Nice Plants Menu compatibility is applied when that mod is present; Dubs Mint Menus works through the standard Info Card path.
CCTO also serves as a lightweight XML-facing framework: other mods can assign explicit cold-death temperatures and cold dormancy to their own plants without replacing the plant class.
